model2.bytedance_note: Doubao and Jimeng render with one shared ByteDance generator lineage.
model2.abstain_note: Decoupled 11-channel regime-standardized acceptance detector plus 10-way skip attribution head in pure NumPy. Unsupported generators (such as Qwen, Kling, Yuanbao, Hailuo, Hunyuan) and images below the calibrated acceptance threshold or under 256x256 abstain to provider=null.

receipt_gate.head: linear on the CLIP-L-ft 768-d vector Model 1 already computes
receipt_gate.train: CORD-v2 train 800 (CC BY 4.0) + 200 synthetic receipts + phone positives (dup3 in 2026-09-07 stable gate) + 2400 ai_train negatives
receipt_gate.certified: min of 1st-percentile scores on CORD validation and a synthetic holdout; no field-receipt pixels in threshold selection
receipt_gate.measured: field receipts 59/59 gated on stable receipt-gate.npz (57/59 on 2026-09-02 fallback); CORD 99/99 gated; ai_test DEFINITELY cost 5/1847 (0.27%)
